id: \rHah. Now you have to fight me.
en: \rHah. Now you have to fight me.

id: \rNormal types have no advantages, but they can be very diverse.
en: \rNormal types have no advantages, but they can be very diverse.
it: \rI Pokémon di tipo Normale non hanno vantaggi, ma possono essere molto versatili.

id: \bNorman uses Normal type Pokémon. They are weak against only the Fighting type.
en: \bNorman uses Normal type Pokémon. They are weak against only the Fighting type.
it: \bNorman usa Pokémon di tipo Normale. Sono deboli solo contro il tipo Lotta.

id: \bThey are strong against nothing. They are immune to Ghost type moves as well.
en: \bThey are strong against nothing. They are immune to Ghost type moves as well.
it: \bNon sono superefficaci contro nessun tipo. In più, sono immuni alle mosse di tipo Spettro.

id: \bNorman: Hello again, \PN. My daughter continues to sing high praise of you.
en: \bNorman: Hello again, \PN. My daughter continues to sing high praise of you.
it: \bNorman: Ciao di nuovo, \PN. Mia figlia continua a tessere le tue lodi.

id: \bNow that we're starting our official battle, I hope you don't disappoint me.
en: \bNow that we're starting our official battle, I hope you don't disappoint me.
it: \bOra che iniziamo la nostra lotta ufficiale, spero che non mi deluderai.
\bNorman: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Equilibrio.

id: \bTM15 contains Hyper Beam. It's a powerful Normal attack.
en: \bTM15 contains Hyper Beam. It's a powerful Normal attack.
it: \bLa MT15 contiene Iper Raggio. È un potente attacco di tipo Normale.

id: \bYou have five badges now. I suggest you head to Fortree City next. You can get there by going to Route 118 from Mauville City.
en: \bYou have five badges now. I suggest you head to Fortree City next. You can get there by going to Route 118 from Mauville City.
it: \bOra hai cinque medaglie. Ti consiglio di andare a Forestopoli. Puoi arrivarci dal Percorso 118 partendo da Ciclamipoli.

id: \bNorman: I'm impressed with your skill. Be sure to grow even stronger.
en: \bNorman: I'm impressed with your skill. Be sure to grow even stronger.
it: \bNorman: Sono colpito dalla tua abilità. Continua a diventare sempre più forte.

id: \bNorman's team is so good they have to rest during battle from working so hard.
en: \bNorman's team is so good they have to rest during battle from working so hard.
it: \bLa squadra di Norman è così forte che durante la lotta deve riposarsi per quanto si impegna.

id: \bDon't even begin to think that you're ready.
en: \bDon't even begin to think that you're ready.
it: \bNon pensare nemmeno lontanamente di essere pronto.
